name: 代词使用模式
description: 分析 代词 分布 (personal, demonstrative, relative) 以检测 AI生成的 text's distinctive 代词 avoidance 模式.
useCase: Detecting AI text through systematic differences in 代词 usage frequency and variety
mechanism: Categorizes and quantifies 代词 usage 跨 subcategories: first-person (I, we, me), second-person (you, your), third-person (he, she, they), demonstrative (this, that, these), and relative (其, that, who). AI生成的 text typically underuses first-person 代词s, overuses impersonal constructions ('it is', 'one can'), and shows less pronominal variety. The method computes 代词 density, category ratios, and positional 模式.
accuracy: 中等 - 70-80% on opinion and narrative text
source: Pennebaker, J. W. (2011) - The Secret Life of Pronouns: What Our Words Say About Us, Bloomsbury Press
algorithm: Pronoun Categorization + Density Analysis + Category Ratio Comparison + Positional Mapping
parameters: Categories: PRP/PRP$/WP/DT, Density: per 100 words, Ratios: 1st/3rd person, self-reference index, Normalization: genre-adjusted
strengths:
• 代词携带强烈的心理和文体信号
• 易于提取和分析
• 对个人和观点文本有效
• 有广泛的心理语言学研究支持
limitations:
• Less useful for technical or instructional text
• Cultural and genre differences affect baseline
• AI can be prompted to use specific 代词 模式
• Needs genre-specific reference 分布s

references.title: Pennebaker, J. W. (2011). The Secret Life of Pronouns: What Our Words Say About Us. Bloomsbury Press.
Crothers, E. et al. (2023). Machine-Generated Text: A Comprehensive Survey of Threat Models and Detection Methods. IEEE Access.
Newman, M. L. et al. (2003). Lying Words: Predicting Deception from Linguistic Styles. Personality and Social Psychology Bulletin.
